name: Shoya Chiba
bio: Shoya Chiba (千葉 翔也, Chiba Shōya, August 29, 1995) is a Japanese actor and voice actor (seiyū) from Tokyo. He is affiliated with Toys Factory.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
credits.overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

credits.title: Summer Pockets Season 1: Omnibus - The Girl Who Forgot Summer Vacation
credits.overview: A theatrical compilation film covering episodes 15–17 of the TV anime Summer Pockets.  Shiroha's teaching herself to swim in preparation for an event, the details of which she's reluctant to share.

credits.title: Summer Pockets Season 1: Omnibus - Dawn Memories
credits.overview: A theatrical compilation film covering episodes 11–14 of the TV anime Summer Pockets.  Ao never seems to get enough sleep. She is tasked with an important ritual that takes place at night.

credits.title: Summer Pockets Season 1: Omnibus - A Lifetime's Worth of Summer Breaks
credits.overview: A theatrical compilation film covering episodes 7–10 of the TV anime Summer Pockets.  Tsumugi is trying to understand why she's on Torishirojima Island -- or why she is at all.

credits.title: Summer Pockets Season 1: Omnibus - Across the Seven Seas
credits.overview: A theatrical compilation film covering episodes 3–6 of the TV anime Summer Pockets.  Hairi arrives on Torishirojima Island, where he meets a girl, Kamome, who dreams of going on an adventure.

credits.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
credits.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

credits.title: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX -Beginning-
credits.overview: High-school student Amate Yuzuriha lives peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. But when she meets a war refugee named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle. Theatrical compilation of the first few episodes of Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX.

credits.title: THE IDOLM@STER SideM 9th STAGE ~MIR＠-CIRCLE CRESCENDO~ (DAY 1)
credits.overview: THE IDOLM@STER SideM 9th STAGE ~MIR＠-CIRCLE CRESCENDO~ was a two-day live concert that took place in Makuhari Messe International Exhibit Hall 9-11 on July 13th, 2024.

credits.title: Ya Boy Kongming! Road to Summer Sonia
credits.overview: The music industry becomes a battlefield when ancient strategist Kongming is transported from historical China to modern Japan. He'll use military tactics to turn his new friend Eiko into a music star, and together they'll take the party hotspot of Shibuya by storm!

credits.title: THE IDOLM@STER SideM 8th STAGE ～ALL H@NDS TOGETHER～
credits.overview: THE IDOLM@STER SideM 8th STAGE ～ALL H@NDS TOGETHER～ was a two-day live concert event that took place on October 28th and 29th, 2023 in K-Arena Yokohama.

credits.title: Mai Mai Miracle
credits.overview: Inspired by her grandfather's stories, young Shinko embarks on wild flights of fancy about the history of the little town she lives in. But dreams can't fend off the realities of growing up.
